name: ddc_rotator_lut12
description: NCO + complex mixer + gain (12-bit sine table) vs rotator_cc + multiply_const_cc

params.initial_phase_note: (-phase_inc) mod 65536: ExHdl adds phase_inc before the lookup, so the first sample uses phase 0 like rotator_cc

expect.rationale: Phase truncated to 12 bits: error uniform in [0, 2*pi/2^12), power (2*pi/2^12)^2/3 -> SNR 61.1 dB. Per sample: |x| * gain * 2*pi/2^12 with |x| <= 0.66 and gain 0.8 (26.5 LSB), plus up to 3 LSB from the two truncating shifts and the 32767 table amplitude.
